name: Attribution
description: Provides content attribution and license configuration.
project_description:
The Attribution module provides content attribution and license configuration for the site and for any fieldable entity as e.g. nodes and media. It provides a set of default licenses and allows for import of additional licenses from the list of SPDX license list and custom defined licenses.

 The module provides

 
 A field type for usage with all fieldable entities 
 Multiple field formatters from plain text to preformatted creative commons icons 
 An configurable attribution and copyright block to be placed e.g. in the site's footer or sidebar 
 Embedding via media library is supported 
 Defined licenses are exportable configuration 
 
 The list of licenses includes more than 400 licenses including the various flavors and versions of the Creative Commons and of course the GNU General Public License.

 A short excerpt from the list of available licenses 

 
 
 Creative Commons Attribution Share Alike 4.0 
 CC-BY-SA-4.0 
 
 
 GNU General Public License v2.0 or later 
 GPL-2.0-or-later 
 
 
 MIT License 
 MIT 
 
 
 All rights reserved 
 
 
 
 For a list of all supported licenses 

 https://spdx.org/licenses/
